about: Each case breaks P1: a contract planted in plan.md, on the intent the human decided (plan stage), or work in project/ that leaves the contract the human approved (review stage). 'code' names the rule of cg.py claims that finds its part, or null when only judgement can; at the plan stage code's part is cg.py validate, which the plan passes. '@plan' is the plan of the built project, which the human approved. A finding catches a case when its pointer is 'file' at the line that holds 'text', or one of 'also', three lines either way, or is one of 'or', where 'record' is a record under .cg-docs/evidence/. 'work' is the work as it went: for each slice the checks that ran. 'claims' has the runner run cg.py claims once every slice is done, as the work playbook does.

plan.flag: a check that names its requirement and passes with it broken
a pass condition that is a matter of opinion
the wrong result of the intent, with no check that fails on it

review.flag: something the contract names that was not built
a value of the contract changed with no amendment
a requirement built otherwise than the contract says
something built that the contract does not name
